mutations.because: the start-of-line anchor on the failed-tests pattern is dropped. Without the `^` anchor the pattern matches 'Tests 3 failed' anywhere in a line, so a green run that merely holds those words (a test title, a log line) is failed by the scan — violating N2. This pattern moved out of scripts/gate.sh into scripts/test-output-scan.sh, so the entry is re-anchored to that file (same mutation, file changed). The mutates the clean-run test, which goes red on a non-zero status it expected to be 0.
command: a clean summary and a title that holds the word failed do not fail the gate

mutations.because: the scan result is ignored when deciding the gate's result: dropping the exit 96 so a step that exits 0 while its output reports failed tests is no longer promoted. The mutates the failed-tests scan test, which goes red on the status it expected to be 96.
command: a test step that exits 0 while its output reports failed tests fails the gate with code 96

mutations.because: the scan overrides a failing step's own code: dropping the exit-0 guard so a step that exits 3 while its output reports failed tests is promoted to 96 instead of keeping its own code. The mutates the failing-step test, which goes red on the status it expected to be 3.
command: a failing test step fails the gate with its own code whatever the scan finds
